The '''1957 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship''' was the 71st staging of the All-Ireland [[hurling]] championship since its establishment by the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]] in 1887. The championship began on 14 April 1957 and ended on 1 September 1957.

[[Wexford GAA|Wexford]] were the [[1956 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|defending champions]], however, they were defeated in the provincial campaign.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.askaboutireland.ie/reading-room/sports-recreation/sport/wexford-hurling/wexford-hurling-in-the-19/all-ireland-win-1956/|title=All-Ireland win 1956|publisher=Ask About Ireland website|access-date=21 October 2013}}</ref> [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] won the All-Ireland following a 4–10 to 3–12 defeat of [[Waterford GAA|Waterford]].

==Rule changes==

Prior to the start of the championship the [[Galway GAA|Galway county board]] put down a motion at the [[Gaelic Athletic Association]]'s (GAA) annual congress seeking immediate entry to the [[Leinster Senior Hurling Championship|Leinster championship]].  Since 1922 Galway's hurlers had no competition in the [[Connacht Senior Hurling Championship|Connacht championship]] and, as a result, they gained automatic entry to the All-Ireland semi-final every year.  This format was seen as hindering the team's chances, however, by being included in the Leinster championship Galway could possibly have more competitive championship games every year.  The motion at congress was eventually withdrawn and the existing format remained intact.

==Teams==

A total of fourteen teams contested the championship, including all of the teams that participated in the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship 1956|1956 championship]]. [[Kerry GAA|Kerry]] returned to the championship after a prolonged absence.

===Miscellaneous===

* The [[English people|English]] actor [[John Gregson]] joined the [[Kilkenny GAA|Kilkenny]] team during the parade at the start of the All-Ireland final as part of his role as a hurler in the film ''[[Rooney (film)|Rooney]]''.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.mayonews.ie/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4835:hurling-and-the-hollywood-link-goes-way-back-in-time&Itemid=51|title=Hurling and the Hollywood link|publisher=The Mayo News|date=26 August 2008|access-date=21 October 2013|first=Michael|last=Commins|archive-date=22 October 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131022012704/http://www.mayonews.ie/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=4835:hurling-and-the-hollywood-link-goes-way-back-in-time&Itemid=51|url-status=dead}}</ref>
